inputs: Exactly R3 H01 seed12 A0 1200 wind/pose observations and hash-bound navigation slice, no gas or source truth

arms.name: checked_cumulative
arms.change: Repeat unchanged half-relaxed Picard solve to existing relative-change tolerance, with explicit linear residual and update-equation checks

arms.name: checked_latest_cell
arms.change: Same checked solve, but replace the prior observation at the same GMRF cell with the latest one; retain last observation in other cells

temporal_interpretation: Latest-cell is a no-window-length last-value spatial baseline, not a calibrated dynamic wind model. It tests the effect of treating repeated old values at a cell as independent timeless evidence. Unvisited-cell estimates can remain stale.
prohibition: No weight/window/House tuning from scores; do not increase iteration limit to hide a numerical failure; no House, gas, source worlds, M3 or multi-seed run
report: Same raw one-step pre-assimilation wind predictions and fixed strata as R3, plus per-observation numerical audit, exact input/code/binary identities, and every failed attempt
interpretation_limit: Numerical convergence is not a proof of correct wind physics; lower local wind RMSE is not spatial calibration, source identifiability, novelty or closed-loop utility. No M1 launch qualification follows automatically.
